'''Isaac''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3631 BBY]] he resided on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where failed Jedi trainee [[Languss Tuno]] had been pestering Isaac to take him on as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and teach him the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Isaac instead used Guss as his errand boy, teaching him how to use the Force to get discounts on his drinks such as [[Tarisian ale]]. When Guss brought a visitor, [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]], to his apartment, Isaac made a wager with the Outlander: if the Outlander could teach Guss to perform a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]], Isaac would owe them a favor, otherwise the Outlander would owe Isaac a favor. After the Outlander took Guss to try out this challenge, the two met Isaac in the [[Promenade]] cantina, where Isaac allowed the Outlander to take Guss with them to join the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]]. Isaac admitted that he never completed his Padawan training during his youth and asked the Outlander to treat Guss well.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Isaac appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the Guss Tuno Alliance alert mission.<ref name="SWTOR" />
